title: The Relief Roster
short_role: Choose recovery capacity or confidence before Twinwatch's final pressure.
setup: The relief roster is short. Masons can bring supplies up the ridge, or veterans can steady the two posts.

choices.label: Haul ridge stone (+4 materials)
choices.visible_result: Four materials become available for the last repair decision.

choices.label: Steady both posts (+1 morale)
choices.visible_result: Morale rises by one while the structural budget stays fixed.
